R661.note: Manual escape of *()\ and NUL correctly neutralizes LDAP metacharacters per RFC 4515; behavior preserved.

R662.note: Primary fix's `var sql = $"..."` infers type string, not FormattableString, so ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync(sql) will not compile; the alternate SqlParameter version is correct and workable.

R663.note: Removes the manufacturing second URLDecoder.decode() and adds canonical-path containment check; correctly closes the double-decode traversal.

R664.note: Extension allowlist plus UUID-generated filename correctly closes the sink; rename is disclosed and response still reports the stored path.

R665.note: is_callable($formatter) still allows any real PHP function name (e.g. system/shell_exec/exec) to be invoked with attacker-controlled $vars, so the RCE persists just moved from eval to direct call.

R666.note: Magic-byte detection via http.DetectContentType plus random filename correctly closes the sink; buffer is seeked back before copy so full content is saved.

R667.note: Correctly replaces BinaryFormatter with typed System.Text.Json, but silently switches the wire format from binary to JSON without flagging that existing callers sending the old binary format will now fail.

R668.note: Upload-side validation and UUID renaming are solid, but avatar_lookup.go (same call chain) still reads by original filename and is left unfixed -- write-up does explicitly flag this as a required follow-up, so it is disclosed rather than silent.

R669.note: fgets with sizeof bound plus newline strip correctly replaces gets() while restoring gets()-equivalent (no trailing newline) output.

R670.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores Django's default CSRF middleware validation for this POST endpoint; consequence (token now required) is explained.

R671.note: Recommended primary fix invents an unverified 'report-generator.exe' replacement; the fallback keeps the vulnerable .bat target and the write-up itself admits ArgumentList does not fully stop cmd.exe re-parsing for batch files, so no option here is a verified, complete closure.

R672.note: DTO-restricted decode with server-side IsAdmin/Balance correctly blocks mass assignment, but switches wire format from gob to JSON, which will break existing callers using the old format -- disclosed in the fix description but not flagged as a compatibility break.

R673.note: FlaskForm's built-in CSRF token/validation is sufficient on its own (independent of CSRFProtect); template token requirement is correctly disclosed.

R674.note: Correctly moves ownership so only the caller frees; error path now logs before freeing, eliminating the UAF with no behavior change.

R675.note: secure=True is the direct, correct fix for CWE-614; combined with existing httponly, no other behavior changes.

R676.note: Strict allowlist regex plus removing the lookupRate registration closes both the Eval() injection and the secondary file-read escalation, but it also removes the rule engine's dynamic rate-lookup capability entirely -- disclosed as a trade-off ('use a separate method... if required elsewhere') rather than restored safely.

R677.note: Magic-byte detection via file-type plus server-controlled extension map correctly replaces the trust-the-header check; write-only-after-validation preserves success behavior.

R678.note:
Swapping th:utext for th:text blanket-escapes bodyHtml, but the service stub returns actual HTML ('

Draft body

'), showing the field is meant to render as HTML -- the correct fix is sanitization, which is only offered as an optional aside, not implemented, so the delivered fix likely breaks the intended rendering.

R679.note: One-line wrap with the existing requireAdmin middleware matches the established pattern exactly; no other behavior change.

R680.note: Adds the missing password comparison before authenticating; both a model-method and direct bcrypt.compare fallback are offered since the User model isn't in scope.

R681.note: GET-to-POST plus [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] is the standard ASP.NET Core CSRF fix; the need to add the token to the confirmation form is disclosed.

R682.note: ProcessBuilder with array args to ping.exe directly avoids the cmd.exe /c re-parsing that enabled shell metacharacter injection; equivalent output for legitimate host/count.

R683.note: Positional $n placeholders with the pg driver correctly parameterize the IN clause; same result set for legitimate id arrays.

R684.note: Re-indexing tasks[activeIndex] after push_back avoids the stale reference; indices remain valid across reallocation so behavior is unchanged.

R685.note: XmlResolver = null is Microsoft's documented mitigation for XmlDocument.LoadXml XXE; return value and legitimate parsing unaffected.

R686.note: Uses JNDI's own filterArgs parameterization (already used for street) for uid too, letting the framework RFC-4515-escape both values; clean, minimal, idiomatic fix.

R687.note: ? placeholder with QueryRow(query, username) correctly parameterizes; same fields returned for legitimate usernames.

R688.note: Capturing bytesSent() before reset() removes the dangling-pointer dereference while preserving the documented 'metric from the original endpoint' semantics.

R689.note: toRealPath() canonicalization plus Path.startsWith containment check correctly closes the traversal; existing catch-all exception handler still applies for missing/invalid paths.

R690.note: json_decode() correctly eliminates PHP object injection, but existing cookies written with the old serialize() format will silently fail to decode until the write-up's disclosed (but unimplemented in-scope) encode-side change is made.

R691.note: enable_shared_from_this plus capturing a shared_ptr in the lambda correctly keeps Widget alive until the queued callback runs; onTimerFired now executes safely instead of UB.

R692.note: @ownerName parameter via SqlCommand.Parameters correctly replaces string.Format concatenation; identical query semantics for legitimate owner names.

R693.note: ? placeholder with pool.execute([userId]) correctly parameterizes the mysql2 query; same result shape for legitimate numeric ids.

R694.note: encode_entities() applied only to the two user-controlled fields (subject/reply), correctly leaving the server-generated status badge markup intact.

R695.note: filterTemplate/filterArgs via JNDI's parameterized search correctly escapes the cn value; passing new SearchControls() matches the documented null-cons default so behavior is unchanged.

R696.note: jwt.verify() with an explicit algorithms allowlist and try/catch correctly replaces unauthenticated jwt.decode(); rejects forged tokens with 401.

R697.note: Passing null envp removes the attacker-controlled environment array entirely; there was no legitimate use for a header value setting process environment variables.

R698.note: Swapping to sax-js-based xml2js structurally removes DTD/external-entity support and preserves the orderId extraction; the cited CVE numbers backing the library-replacement decision are unverified and a narrower libxmljs option fix (dtdload:false) would have been a smaller change, but the delivered fix is technically sound.

R699.note: Drops the reference entirely and re-indexes tasks[activeIndex] at each use; correctly avoids holding any reference across push_back.

R700.note: keyFunc now asserts SigningMethodHMAC and jwt.WithValidMethods further restricts accepted algorithms, correctly closing the alg-confusion/none-algorithm forgery path.
